rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in an unfair manner.

example.english: I think the boss distributes the work unfairly.
example.traditional: 我覺得老闆唔公平咁分配啲工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 lou5 baan2 m4 gung1 ping4 gam2 fan1 pui3 di1 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this when the unfairness specifically comes from favouring one person or side over another.

example.english: Mum treats the two of us unfairly by favouring my younger brother, always giving him more pocket money.
example.traditional: 阿媽偏心咁對我哋兩兄弟，成日畀細佬多啲零用錢。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 pin1 sam1 gam2 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 seng4 jat6 bei2 sai3 lou2 do1 di1 ling4 jung6 cin2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the treatment or outcome is unjust or not reasonable.

example.english: You can't unfairly fire me; it was clearly his mistake.
example.traditional: 你唔可以唔公道咁炒我，明明係佢犯錯。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 gung1 dou6 gam2 caau2 ngo5 ming4 ming4 hai6 keoi5 faan6 co3
